title: Securities Dealing Policy

tiers.name: Employees and Directors
tiers.description: All full-time/part-time employees, contractors/secondees of 3+ months, and Directors. Bound by the general principles in section 3: insider trading law at all times, no personal advantage from non-public information, and a ban on short-term trading (acquiring intending to sell, or selling intending to repurchase, within 3 months).

tiers.name: Directors and Restricted Employees
tiers.description: Directors together with Restricted Employees (CEO, CFO, Company Secretary, Chief General Counsel, their direct reports, Job Grade 1-6 employees, others so designated, and specified executive assistants). Subject to Trading Windows, the clearance/notification regime, the margin loan and security restriction, and an absolute ban on hedges/derivatives over Myer Securities.

tiers.name: Chair of the Board
tiers.description: Distinguished only for clearance: notifies and obtains clearance from the Board itself, rather than from an individual Designated Superior.

tiers.name: Other Directors (including CEO)
tiers.description: Directors other than the Chair; clear via the Chair of the Board, and (unlike other Restricted Employees) must provide sufficient trade detail to enable Myer to file an ASX Listing Rule notice within 5 working days of the Trade.

tiers.name: KMPs
tiers.description: CEO, CFO, Company Secretary, Chief General Counsel, and direct reports of the CEO. Require advance approval from the CEO and notify the CEO or Company Secretary.

tiers.name: Other Restricted Employees
tiers.description: Restricted Employees who are not Directors or KMPs (e.g. direct reports of the CFO/Company Secretary/Chief General Counsel, Job Grade 1-6 staff, designated staff, and certain executive assistants). Notify the Company Secretary in advance; Trading is assumed cleared unless the Company Secretary prohibits it at least one working day before the proposed date.

tiers.name: Employees (other than Directors and Restricted Employees)
tiers.description: Ordinary employees who are neither Directors nor Restricted Employees. Not subject to Trading Windows, the clearance/notification regime, the margin loan/security restriction, or the hedge/derivative ban; bound only by the general section 3 principles.

tiers.name: Closely Related Parties
tiers.description: Spouse, child, grandchild, or dependant of a Restricted Employee/Director or their spouse; a family member expected to influence or be influenced by them; a company or superannuation fund they control; or a family trust of which they are a beneficiary. Restricted Employees and Directors must ensure their Closely Related Parties do not use derivatives to hedge unvested or disposal-restricted incentive scheme securities.

definitions.hedging_definition: any derivatives or other products which operate to limit the economic risk of Myer Securities under an employee incentive scheme that are unvested or vested but subject to disposal restrictions

windows.start_anchor: 10.00am on the next trading day after the announcement to ASX of Myer's half yearly results
windows.end_anchor: 6 weeks after the start of the window

windows.start_anchor: 10.00am on the next trading day after the announcement to ASX of Myer's preliminary final statement or full year results
windows.end_anchor: 6 weeks after the start of the window

windows.start_anchor: 10.00am on the next trading day after the holding of Myer's Annual General Meeting
windows.end_anchor: 4 weeks after the start of the window

windows.start_anchor: the date Myer has a current prospectus or other disclosure document on issue under which persons may subscribe for Myer Securities
windows.end_anchor: the date that prospectus or disclosure document ceases to be current

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board of Directors may, from time to time, determine any other period to be a Trading Window (which may apply to one or more Directors/Restricted Employees or groups of them), and at any time may vary, suspend or terminate the Trading Windows for a specified period in its discretion; affected persons will be notified to the extent the Board determines. Confidentiality of these determinations is not addressed.

rules.detail: Absolute, unconditional ban on purchasing or creating any hedge or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities, with no vesting-state qualifier, exception, or clearance route provided; this is separate from and additional to the Trading Window/clearance regime governing ordinary Trades.
rules.evidence: Restricted Employees and Directors must not purchase or create any hedge and/or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities.

rules.tier: Employees (other than Directors and Restricted Employees)
rules.detail: The hedge/derivative ban in 3.1(d) is limited to Directors and Restricted Employees. Ordinary employees may enter a derivative referencing Myer Securities (Securities expressly includes derivatives and other s1042A financial products) subject only to the general insider trading and short-term trading rules, since Trading Windows and clearance apply only to Directors and Restricted Employees.
rules.evidence: Securities includes shares, options, rights, debentures ... derivatives ... and other financial products covered by section 1042A of the Corporations Act.

rules.detail: Extends the ban to each Restricted Employee's or Director's Closely Related Parties specifically for employee-incentive-scheme securities that are unvested.
rules.evidence: All Restricted Employees and Directors must not (and must ensure that their Closely Related Parties do not) use, or allow to be used, any derivatives or other products which operate to limit the economic risk of Myer Securities under an employee incentive scheme that are unvested or vested but subject to disposal restrictions.

rules.detail: Same clause extends the ban to incentive scheme securities that have vested but remain subject to disposal restrictions.
rules.evidence: any derivatives or other products which operate to limit the economic risk of Myer Securities under an employee incentive scheme that are unvested or vested but subject to disposal restrictions.

rules.detail: Even once fully vested and unrestricted, hedging remains barred by the separate, unconditional first sentence of 3.1(d), which is not limited to incentive-scheme securities or any vesting state.
rules.evidence: Restricted Employees and Directors must not purchase or create any hedge and/or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named, but structures such as a prepaid forward or cash-settled swap are a 'hedge and/or derivative ... based on Myer Securities' and so are caught by the outright ban; a non-derivative forward sale agreement would instead be a Trade requiring a Trading Window and clearance under section 4.
rules.evidence: Restricted Employees and Directors must not purchase or create any hedge and/or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities.

rules.detail: Short selling is expressly part of the Deal/Trade definition rather than separately banned, so it follows the ordinary Trading Window and clearance/notification regime for this tier (subject to the general insider trading prohibition).
rules.evidence: Deal in respect of any Security, means to apply for, acquire or dispose of Securities (including exercising an option over Securities) or to enter into an agreement do any of those things (including short selling).

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named anywhere in the Policy and is not listed as an Excluded Dealing or within the Deal definition.
CFDs are not separately named, but a CFD referencing Myer Securities is a derivative 'attached to or based on' those Securities, so it is caught by the same outright ban as any other derivative.
rules.evidence: Restricted Employees and Directors must not purchase or create any hedge and/or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities.

rules.detail: A margin loan or similar funding arrangement to acquire Myer Securities is permitted with prior clearance from the person's Designated Superior, who may make the clearance conditional on terms it sees fit.
rules.evidence: No Director or Restricted Employee may enter into a margin loan or similar funding arrangement to acquire any Myer Securities ... without first obtaining the clearance of that person's Designated Superior.

rules.detail: Granting a lender any rights or security directly over Myer Securities requires prior clearance from the Designated Superior, who may impose conditions.
rules.evidence: No Director or Restricted Employee may ... grant lenders any rights or security directly over their Myer Securities without first obtaining the clearance of that person's Designated Superior.

rules.detail: Clause 4.6 covers both borrowing to acquire Myer Securities and granting security over Myer Securities generally, so it functions as a broad secured-financing clearance regime, not limited to a formal margin loan product.
rules.evidence: No Director or Restricted Employee may enter into a margin loan or similar funding arrangement to acquire any Myer Securities, or grant lenders any rights or security directly over their Myer Securities without first obtaining the clearance of that person's Designated Superior.

rules.detail: Bans acquiring with intent to sell within 3 months, or selling with a view to repurchase within 3 months; applies to all Employees and Directors, with no carve-out stated for incentive scheme securities.
rules.evidence: Employees and Directors must not engage in short term Trading of Myer Securities. In general, the Board of Directors consider the following to be transactions of a short term nature: acquiring Securities with an intention to sell within a 3 month period; or selling Securities with a view to repurchase within a 3 month period.

clearance.post_trade_deadline: within 2 working days of Trading; ASX notice within 5 working days of the Trade
clearance.evidence: Chair of the Board / The Board [Designated Superior table]. If you are a Director or KMP, you must seek prior written clearance before undertaking any Trading of Myer Securities.

clearance.post_trade_deadline: within 2 working days of Trading; Directors must give sufficient detail to enable an ASX Listing Rule notice within 5 working days of the Trade
clearance.evidence: Directors and KMPs must notify the Designated Superior at least 3 working days in advance of any proposed Trading of Myer Securities. ... Directors must provide sufficient details of all Trading to enable Myer to file a notice in accordance with the ASX Listing Rules within 5 working days of the Trade.
KMPs / Approval: CEO; Notification: CEO or Company Secretary [Designated Superior table].

After providing advanced notification of the proposed Trading of Myer Securities ... a Restricted Employee (other than a Director or KMP) may ... undertake the notified Trade ... unless the Designated Superior ... has notified you that the notified Trading ... is prohibited ... at least one working day prior to the proposed date.

short_term.basis: acquiring with intention to sell within 3 months, or selling with a view to repurchase within 3 months
short_term.evidence: acquiring Securities with an intention to sell within a 3 month period; or selling Securities with a view to repurchase within a 3 month period.

exceptions.evidence: participation in Myer's employee shares, options or share rights plans (including accepting an offer to participate or applying for an allocation of Myer Securities). ... Options and share rights may only be exercised within the Trading Windows.
acquisition of Myer Securities through a dividend or distribution reinvestment plan.
acquisition of Myer Securities through a share purchase plan available to all retail shareholders.
acquisition of Myer Securities through a pro rata issue.
disposal of rights acquired under a pro rata issue.
the disposal of Myer Securities through the acceptance of a takeover offer, scheme of arrangement or equal access buy back.
Trades that do not result in a change to the beneficial interest in the Myer Securities.
Trades that transfer Myer Securities to another holding in your own name, to your Closely Related Party or to their superannuation fund.

Dealing with financial instruments or accounts where underlying investment decisions are not (and cannot be) made or influenced by you or your Closely Related Parties. For example, contributions into a superannuation fund (excluding SMSFs), investments in non-discretionary funds or funds of funds and cash deposit accounts.
Subject to section 4.6, a disposal of Myer Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under a margin lending arrangement.
where you are facing severe financial hardship and can only meet your financial commitments by selling your Myer Securities.
where you are required by a court order or court enforceable undertaking (e.g. in a bona fide family settlement) or some other overriding legal or regulatory requirement to Trade Myer Securities.
any other circumstance that is deemed to be an Exceptional Circumstance by the Designated Superior.

financing_disclosure: Directors and Restricted Employees: trigger = inception of a margin loan/funding arrangement to acquire Myer Securities, or granting any lender rights or security over Myer Securities; to that person's Designated Superior for clearance; deadline = before entering into the arrangement.

exemption_authority: The relevant Designated Superior (the Board for the Chair, the Chair for other Directors, the CEO for KMPs, the Company Secretary for other Restricted Employees) may waive compliance with the Trading Window requirement in section 4.2 for severe financial hardship, a court order/enforceable undertaking, or any other circumstance it deems exceptional, at Myer's sole discretion on a case-by-case basis; any clearance granted lasts no more than 2 working days and may be withdrawn if circumstances change (4.8).
jurisdiction_overlays: Securities includes Myer's American Depositary Receipts tradeable in the US through a Sponsored Level 1 ADR program, bringing US-traded instruments within the Policy's scope.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Employees and Directors must not purchase or create any hedge and/or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This single sentence rules out the put and call legs of a funded collar for Directors and Restricted Employees at any vesting state, with no exception or clearance route.

bespoke_clauses.topic: extended ban to Closely Related Parties
bespoke_clauses.clause: All Restricted Employees and Directors must not (and must ensure that their Closely Related Parties do not) use, or allow to be used, any derivatives or other products which operate to limit the economic risk of Myer Securities under an employee incentive scheme that are unvested or vested but subject to disposal restrictions.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing a hedge on unvested or lock-restricted incentive shares through a spouse, family trust or controlled company does not avoid the ban.

bespoke_clauses.clause: That person's Designated Superior may, at the Designated Superior's discretion, make any clearance for the purposes of this section 4.6 conditional on such terms and conditions as the Designated Superior sees fit.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A plain secured loan against vested Myer shares (not styled as a derivative) can proceed with Designated Superior clearance, but this only supports the loan leg, not the banned hedge legs of a true collar.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Subject to section 4.6, a disposal of Myer Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under a margin lending arrangement.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A lender's enforcement sale on default is a pre-cleared Excluded Dealing that can occur outside a Trading Window, provided the original financing was cleared under 4.6.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Securities includes Myer's American Depositary Receipts which are able to be traded in the US through a Sponsored Level 1 American Depositary Receipt program.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring around Myer's ASX-listed shares by referencing the US ADRs instead does not escape the Policy, as ADRs are expressly within 'Securities'.

bespoke_clauses.clause: In each case where a clearance is granted, the duration of that clearance to deal in Myer Securities will be no more than 2 working days.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even where a waiver or clearance for the loan leg is obtained, execution must occur within a very short window (2 working days for exceptional-circumstances clearance, 5 working days for ordinary clearance), requiring tight coordination with the bank.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Myer adopts the broader concept of "dealing" for the purposes of this Policy. Myer considers Dealing to include, without limitation, Securities transactions such as transfers of beneficial ownership and trading (either directly or indirectly).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Signals that indirect or intermediated structures used to access economic exposure to Myer shares will still be treated as Dealing/Trading.

summary: A funded collar with a bank is not achievable for Directors, KMPs or other Restricted Employees under this policy: clause 3.1(d) imposes an absolute, unconditional ban on purchasing or creating any hedge or derivative attached to or based on Myer Securities, with no carve-out for vested, unrestricted shares and no clearance or exception route to lift it. The ban is also extended to each Restricted Employee's or Director's Closely Related Parties for incentive-scheme securities that are unvested or subject to disposal restrictions, closing off indirect routes. The loan leg alone is not banned outright: a plain margin loan or similar funding arrangement, or granting a lender security over Myer Securities, is permitted with prior written clearance from the person's Designated Superior (which may be made conditional), and a lender's enforcement sale on default is a pre-cleared Excluded Dealing. Ordinary employees who are neither Directors nor Restricted Employees are not subject to the derivatives ban or the clearance regime, but they are not the audience for this product. Overall, only the unhedged, secured-loan component of a collar could proceed with clearance; the put and call derivative legs cannot be implemented while the individual remains a Director or Restricted Employee.
